mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months (indicating an easing monetary policy) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A unemployment rate above 6.0% (indicating economic weakness) triggers expectations of reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS increase by more than 0.5% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 (indicating a manufacturing slowdown) triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls below 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of real GDP (GDPC1) relative to its 5-year moving average indicates robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 is above its 5-year moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI reading above 265.0 (indicating elevated inflation) triggers expectations of monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 265.0.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong employment growth (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market, which typically precedes stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% and UNRATE falls by more than 0.2 percentage points in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply contraction regime (indicated by declining industrial production), manufacturing output slowdowns lead to reduced corporate profits and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines for two consecutive months.
